slides.headline: 6 TASKS YOU'D HIRE A DEVELOPER FOR THAT CLAUDE CODE DOES FREE
slides.image_prompt: Magician's top hat on stage releasing glowing Claude logo surrounded by gold and amber-orange dollar signs, checkmarks, warning triangles against deep scarlet curtains, spotlight.

slides.headline: 1) TURN A DESCRIPTION INTO A WORKING APP
slides.body: Claude Code writes every file, connects them, and hands you something that actually runs. Prompt: "Build me an app that [describe what it does]. Run in a browser, save data between sessions."

slides.headline: 2) PASTE ANY ERROR. GET THE FIX IN SECONDS.
slides.body: Bugs that hide three files deep used to take engineers hours. Prompt: "Here is the error: [paste error]. Here is the code: [paste code]. Find the bug and tell me what caused it."

slides.headline: 3) UNDERSTAND ANY CODEBASE IN MINUTES
slides.body: Claude Code reads every file and maps how they connect. No documentation needed. Prompt: "[paste code]. What does each file do and where do I change [what you want]?"

slides.headline: 4) MAKE YOUR CODE IMPOSSIBLE TO BREAK
slides.body: Claude Code does not just write tests, it runs them, fixes failures, and loops until every single test passes. Prompt: "[paste code]. Write tests, run them, fix failures, show results."

slides.headline: 5) TURN A SPREADSHEET INTO A REAL WEB TOOL
slides.body: Claude Code builds a proper tool with search, filters, and sorting from any spreadsheet in one session. Prompt: "I track [what] with columns [list]. Build a web app with search, filters, and editable rows."

slides.headline: 6) ADD ANY FEATURE TO CODE YOU ALREADY OWN
slides.body: Paste any code and Claude Code writes the new feature into your existing files without breaking what works. Prompt: "[paste code]. Add [describe feature]. Do not break anything that currently works."

slides.headline: SAVE THIS FOR TONIGHT
slides.body:
All six work right now, no experience needed. Try tonight: "Build me an app that [describe it]. Run in a browser and save data."

Daily AI news and real skills, every day.

caption:
Swipe through. 🛠️ Six Claude Code powers most people walk straight past, and a copy-paste prompt for each one you can try tonight.

Build a working app from a plain description, fix any error by pasting it in, understand any codebase in minutes, write tests that run themselves until they all pass, turn a spreadsheet into a proper web tool, add any feature to code you already own.

Claude Code has improved every few weeks through summer 2026. The gap between an idea and a working product is now one conversation. Most people still think this is a tool for engineers. It is not. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we will show you what Claude Code could automate for yours.
